"""Pure offline replay: retained bytes/Source queries/PE exports only, no SDK/COM/OS calls."""
import hashlib, json, pathlib, re, sys
import pefile

root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
report_path=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else root/'reports/cc12_fmod_audio_endpoint_startup_recheck.json'
report=json.loads(report_path.read_text())
pin_count=0;unique=set()
def walk(value):
    global pin_count
    if isinstance(value,dict):
        retained=value.get('retained_path','').replace('\\','/')
        if retained.startswith('local/cc12_audio_endpoint_startup_recheck/frozen/') and 'sha256' in value:
            data=(root/retained).read_bytes()
            assert len(data)==value['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==value['sha256'],value
            pin_count+=1;unique.add(retained)
        for item in value.values():walk(item)
    elif isinstance(value,list):
        for item in value:walk(item)
walk(report)
source={pathlib.Path(p['path']).relative_to(root).as_posix():(root/p['retained_path']).read_text() for p in report['current_source']['pins']}
query={'cli_parser_flags':sorted(set(re.findall(r'std::strcmp\(argument, "([^"]+)"',source['src/game_hosts.cpp']))),
       'no_audio_or_headless_cli_selector_found':not any(f in source['src/game_hosts.cpp'] for f in ['"--headless"','"--no-audio"','"--nosound"','"--no-sound"']),
       'sound_enabled_constructor_seed_true':'byte(p,0x24,1)' in source['src/native_game_settings_owner.cpp'],
       'soundenabled_loader_consumes_no_value':'matched=true;if(k==9)break; // SoundEnabled never reads its value.' in source['src/native_settings_loader.cpp'],
       'read_view_copies_actual_24h_flag':'a.enabled_24=flag(p,0x24)' in source['src/game_native_settings_application.cpp'],
       'startup_passes_inverse_enable':'sound_->core.startup(!settings_view_.audio.enabled_24)' in source['src/game_hosts.cpp'],
       'genuine_disabled_sound_nosound_branch':'host.system_set_output(state.system, FmodOutputType::nosound)' in source['src/audio_online_startup.cpp']}
assert query==report['current_source']['query']
types=json.loads(source['config/fmod_ex_types.json'])
assert [v for v in types['enums']['FMOD_RESULT'] if v[1] in [37,61,78]]==report['local_enum_validation']['result_values']
normalized=0
for row in report['current_source']['source993_freeze']['relevant_frozen_source_replay']:
    frozen=(root/row['Source993_retained_pin']['retained_path']).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
    current=next(p for p in report['current_source']['pins'] if pathlib.Path(p['path']).relative_to(root).as_posix()==row['path'])
    worker=(root/current['retained_path']).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
    assert hashlib.sha256(frozen).hexdigest()==row['Source993_lf_sha256']
    assert hashlib.sha256(worker).hexdigest()==row['worker_current_lf_sha256']
    assert (frozen==worker)==row['lf_normalized_identical']
    normalized+=1
for item in report['installed_dlls']:
    pe=pefile.PE(str(root/item['pin']['retained_path']))
    exports=[e.name.decode() for e in pe.DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT.symbols if e.name]
    assert len(exports)==item['export_count'] and all(n in exports for n in item['selected_export_metadata'])
    assert f'{pe.FILE_HEADER.Machine:04x}'==item['PE_machine_hex']
probe=report['current_win32_sdk_readonly_probe'];assert probe['exit_code']==0
assert not any(n in probe['source_text'] for n in ['"FMOD_System_Set','"_FMOD_EventSystem_Init@','"FMOD_System_Init"'])
observed={row.get('step'):row for row in probe['stdout']}
assert observed['System_GetNumDrivers']['result']==0 and observed['System_GetNumDrivers']['observed']==0
assert observed['EventSystem_Release_owns_core_system']['result']==0
assert report['current_environment']['mmdevice']['observed']['native_result']['ActiveRenderCount']==0
for attempt in report['historical_evidence']['Source581_and_frozen_Source539_attempts']:
    assert attempt['exit_record']['exit_code']==1
assert report['historical_evidence']['Source595']['exit_record']['exit_code']==1
result={'scope':'Pure offline hash/query/PE-export replay; no COM, SDK, environment refresh, build, startup or gameplay execution',
        'retained_pin_occurrences_verified':pin_count,'unique_retained_files_verified':len(unique),
        'current_source_queries_verified':True,'source993_full_file_normalized_comparisons_verified':normalized,
        'installed_DLL_export_metadata_replayed':2,'historical_failed_runtime_attempts_preserved':3,
        'new_FMOD_init_or_startup_credit':False,'result':'pass'}
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
